title: Daily Source Pass
summary: Today's issue is built from Eastpoint, Tennessean/AOL, Metro East Bank, Nashville Public Library, venue listings, Nashville.gov, and a supervised East Nashville Facebook group poll. Private-platform material is labeled and redacted.

stages.name: Eastpoint Kickoff Check
stages.goal: Confirm today's public kickoff and attach development context.
stages.output: Confirmed Eastpoint's May 30 kickoff and connected it to the reported Eastpoint Flats construction start.

stages.name: Facebook Group Poll
stages.goal: Poll the private East Nashville group without publishing private details.
stages.output: Captured three useful lanes from New posts: a Dee's ticket-launch lead to verify, rental-price discourse to anonymize, and a free-couch classified to hold.

stages.name: Library And Family Utility
stages.output: Confirmed East Branch Summer Reading Challenge kickoff listings and Saturday hours.

stages.name: Venue Scan
stages.goal: Build the Saturday East Nashville music lane.
stages.output: Confirmed Fulton Lee at The Basement East, Kasvot Chatt at Eastside Bowl, and Kip Moore at The East Room.

stages.name: Metro Outdoor Utility
stages.goal: Add official cleanup and outdoor-service options.
stages.output: Pulled Brown's Creek, Whites Creek, and Little Marrowbone cleanup listings from Nashville.gov.

stages.name: Publish Pack
stages.goal: Ship source-backed web stories and newsletter-ready copy.
stages.output: Six May 30 stories are ready with source trails, labels, social cuts, and generated/fallback covers.

publishQueue.why: It explains the public-source run and the supervised Facebook group poll in one package.
The official event is today and follows the reported Eastpoint Flats construction start.

publishQueue.decision: Published as anonymized Group Chat Says.
publishQueue.why: The poll has useful local signals, but private details stay redacted and verification gates are explicit.
The East Branch listings are public, local, and useful before the events start.

publishQueue.decision: Published as confirmed East Nashville music calendar.
publishQueue.why: The venue listings have public time/place details and direct reader utility.
It gives readers an official Saturday service option without overstating East-side exclusivity.

accessNeeds.name: Facebook group
accessNeeds.today: Poll found one calendar lead to verify, one rental-pressure signal to anonymize, and one transient classified to hold.
accessNeeds.guardrail: Do not publish raw private-citizen screenshots, kids, medical/financial details, private addresses, plates, phones, or unverified accusations.

accessNeeds.name: Nextdoor
accessNeeds.guardrail: Treat as neighborhood signal until independently verified; redact sensitive personal details.

accessNeeds.today: Search for a public ticket/event link before upgrading the Facebook lead to the calendar.
